name: The Adventuring Party
description: A band of adventurers gathers at the tavern — each a different race, wielding a different weapon. Work out who's who.
clues: Either Lyra goes with Wolf or Raven goes with Conjuration.
Rat, Raven, and Toad go with Orin, Wrenna, and Conjuration, in some order.
If Mara goes with Rat, then Wolf goes with Conjuration.
Exactly two of these are true: Lyra goes with Toad; Orin goes with Enchantment; Evocation goes with Raven.

hints.text: Suppose Conjuration went with Wolf — following the clues from there hits a contradiction, so it doesn't.
chain: Start by assuming Conjuration goes with Wolf.
Conjuration goes with Wolf, so it can't also go with Rat.
Conjuration goes with Wolf, so it can't also go with Raven.
Conjuration goes with Wolf, so it can't also go with Toad.
…but now the clue “Rat, Raven, and Toad go with Orin, Wrenna, and Conjuration, in some order” can no longer hold — a contradiction.
So Conjuration does not go with Wolf.
